name: Dirge Quikcleave
summary: Inside Gadgetzan's inn, Dirge Quikcleave welcomes travelers with food and drink. This goblin calls himself Azeroth's greatest living culinary artist, and chefs come to him when they are ready for artisan cooking.

sections.title: Master of the Cleaver
sections.body: In dusty Gadgetzan, Dirge Quikcleave serves food and drink to travelers crossing the Tanaris sands. He claims to be Azeroth's greatest living culinary artist, though his kitchen stands in a frontier tavern. When city cooking lessons are spent, trainers send their most promising students to him. His demanding recipes call for rare ingredients, from giant clam meat and eggs for his Clamlette creations to beasts from distant shores.

sections.title: Exotic Flavors and Shady Favors
sections.body: Dirge Quikcleave brings a gourmand's bravado and a goblin's eye for business to his work. Across Kalimdor, he keeps company with eccentric figures and pursues dangerous culinary ventures. Those who bring him fierce beast cuts can receive hearty recipes for champions facing perilous journeys. The monstrous chimaeroks of Feralas's Isle of Dread provide one such ingredient. Dirge's private dealings are best left unquestioned.

faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave is a goblin chef and provisioner inside the inn at Gadgetzan, Tanaris. Renowned as one of Azeroth's finest cooks, he teaches aspiring chefs to hone their craft toward artisan mastery.

faq.q: Where can Dirge Quikcleave be found?
faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave can be found inside the tavern in Gadgetzan, a Steamwheedle cartel boomtown in the northern dunes of Tanaris.

faq.q: Why do cooking trainers send adventurers to him?
faq.answer: Cooking trainers in the capital cities can take an apprentice only so far. When a cook reaches the expert threshold, they send that cook to Dirge in Gadgetzan through 'To Gadgetzan You Go!' to prove their worth and unlock artisan cooking.

faq.q: What dishes is Dirge famous for?
faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave is known for Clamlette Surprise, a savory omelet made from giant clam meat and eggs, hearty wolf steaks, and his potent Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops.

angles.text: As an ambitious chef, you can seek Dirge Quikcleave's artisan instruction. He tests your skill with his signature clamlette recipes before granting master status.
As an aspiring Horde gourmand, you are sent straight from Orgrimmar by its trainers to seek Dirge's culinary tutelage in the Tanaris desert.
